newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asia oil sentiment weak, refiners look to August.
newsitem.headline: Asia oil sentiment weak, refiners look to August.

text.p: Contagious bearishness from Western markets continued to weigh down crude values in early Asia trade, with notional assessments for Brent shedding 25 cents per barrel from Friday in slow regional trade.
Brokers pegged July Brent at $17.45/17.50, down from Friday's $17.70/17.80 assessment. Simex Aug Brent was bid at $17.70 with no offers at Tokyo midday.
Iraqi posturing for a possible delay of resumed exports gave psychological support to already bearish fundamentals, with both WTI and Brent on a downward slide late last week.
